title: 高可用網站架構
summary: 以SLO、失效域與有限容量網站連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect slos, failure domains and finite-capacity websites through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.

stages.title: 服務與失效契約
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「服務與失效契約」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop service and failure contracts through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: 使用者路徑：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「使用者路徑」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for user paths.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「使用者路徑」的資料、控制與時間關係。首頁存活不代表所有關鍵操作成功。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「畫登入、讀取與寫入路徑。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for user paths. A live homepage does not establish critical-operation success. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Draw login, read and write paths. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 畫登入、讀取與寫入路徑。
steps.observationEn: Draw login, read and write paths.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：兩個 99.9% 元件串列仍是 99.9%。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Two 99.9% components in series still yield 99.9%. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「使用者路徑」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「首頁存活不代表所有關鍵操作成功。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit user paths two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.text: 畫登入、讀取與寫入路徑。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Draw login, read and write paths. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 30 天共 43,200 min，99.9% 可用率的時間型錯誤預算=43.2 min。假設兩元件獨立且皆 99.9%，串列 A=0.999²=99.8001%；備援才可用 1−(1−A)²，獨立假設常不成立。
knowledge.textEn: Thirty days contain 43,200 min; 99.9% time availability permits 43.2 min. Two independent 99.9% components in series yield 99.8001%; redundancy uses 1−(1−A)² only when independence assumptions apply.

steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Different zones remove every common failure. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

knowledge.textEn: Thirty days contain 43,200 min; 99.9% time availability permits 43.2 min. Two independent 99.9% components in series yield 99.8001%; redundancy uses 1−(1−A)² only when independence assumptions apply.
